source.value_definition: Author-supplied within-depot percentages, 100 × source subtype n / total myeloid n within each depot
source.selection: All 16 myeloid subtypes × 3 depots. Display labels transcribed from existing annotations derived from Fig2d.
source.licence_evidence: Existing cell-atlas provenance records Massier paper and Source Data release CC BY 4.0.

candidate_changes: Compact 28.6 × 71.28 mm data region with 9.53 × 4.455 mm cells
SC/OM/PV display aliases retain original depot keys/order; full names remain in caption
48 source-derived value labels displayed to two significant digits; CSV and color mapping retain full precision
Explicit 0.35 pt cell seams and a bright globally linear blue magnitude scale
No inferred clustering, participant replication or inferential test
comparison_preserved: full depot identities in source data and caption; axis/color meanings unchanged

transfer_probe.description: Rename row/column/value fields and switch to the true supplied object counts on the same full 16×3 matrix; use a separately justified 0–2700 count scale.

same_version_refinement.scope: Current main refinements keep version 0.4.3; the published tag remains a historical snapshot. Both source-preserving technical checks and actual-image comparisons are required.
